scope: Both timestep variants fail the unchanged supported-lift gate; completed runtime and browser checks do not promote this to an accepted step.

lift.scope: Consecutive reporting samples simultaneously meet caller-declared geometric clearance, swing unloading and support-force requirements. No interpolation or between-sample guarantee; not a landing, balance, collision, hardware-transfer or walking certificate.

Consecutive reporting samples simultaneously meet caller-declared geometric clearance, swing unloading and support-force requirements. No interpolation or between-sample guarantee; not a landing, balance, collision, hardware-transfer or walking certificate.

floor_force_ratio_diagnostic.scope: Patch resultant |F_xy|/F_z for current world-Z floor law, excluding internal contacts and loads below the stated reporting cutoff. Not a calibrated coefficient, torsional capacity or an acceptance gate.

contact_impulse_comparison.scope: Accepted BE endpoint-force quadrature with complete coverage. Not an exact continuous impulse; no torsional impulse, energy or calibrated accuracy gate.

refinement.scope: Aligned sampled diagnostic only; motor_states and joint arrays contain mixed units. Event occurrence matching is diagnostic, not proof of identical modes. Optional accepted-stage impulse comparison is diagnostic. No energy, hardware or learning gate is established.

browser.scope: Strict 1e-7 absolute entry portability diagnostic over all native sampled frame fields; not hardware accuracy or realtime acceptance. Replay equality excludes measured wall time.
